days.title: Lemon Garlic Chicken with Roasted Broccoli and Rice
steps: Heat the oven to 425. Start the rice.
Toss the chicken with lemon juice, minced garlic, half the oil, salt and pepper. Put it on a sheet pan.
Toss the broccoli with the rest of the oil and a pinch of salt. Put it on the same pan.
Bake 20 to 22 minutes, until the chicken reaches 165. Serve over the rice.

days.title: Turkey Taco Lettuce Bowls
steps: Brown the turkey in a dry pan, 6 to 8 minutes.
Stir in the taco seasoning, beans and a splash of water. Cook 3 minutes.
Fill a bowl with the lettuce and tomato. Spoon the turkey on top.
Finish with the yogurt and salsa.

days.title: Baked Salmon with Green Beans and Sweet Potato
steps: Heat the oven to 400. Cube the sweet potato and roast it with half the oil for 15 minutes.
Add the green beans to the pan with the rest of the oil and salt. Nestle in the salmon.
Roast 12 to 14 minutes, until the salmon flakes.
Squeeze the lemon over everything.

days.title: Chicken and Veggie Stir Fry over Rice
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan on high. Cook the chicken 5 to 6 minutes until done, then set aside.
Cook the vegetables and garlic 4 minutes.
Return the chicken, add the soy sauce and toss 1 minute.
Serve over the rice.

days.title: Shrimp and Veggie Skillet with Quinoa
steps: Heat the oil in a skillet. Cook the zucchini and pepper 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, paprika and shrimp. Cook 3 to 4 minutes until pink.
Serve over the quinoa.

days.title: Turkey and Bean Chili
steps: Brown the turkey with the onion, 7 to 8 minutes.
Add the chili powder, beans, tomatoes and broth.
Simmer 25 minutes, stirring now and then. Salt to taste.

days.title: Sheet Pan Chicken Sausage and Veggies
steps: Heat the oven to 425.
Toss the potatoes, pepper and zucchini with the oil and salt. Roast 15 minutes.
Add the sliced sausage to the pan and roast 12 minutes more.
